source.interpretation: Target-property subset fine-tuning adapted to existing LSTM; not a replication of original GRU architecture or original dataset.

training.pretraining: existing identical ChEMBL checkpoint; no new pretraining
training.subset_selection: is_target in original train split only
training.loss: unit non-padding token weights; same Adam and sparse categorical cross-entropy
training.note: Same update budget, not same target-molecule exposure: existing hard mixes 50% ChEMBL; target-only TL does not.

generation.seeding_note: New fixed stable decoding streams; original arm-specific streams remain unchanged. Pairing is by training seed, not identical sampled random numbers.

evaluation.novelty_reference: entire fixed 30829 RedDB training molecules, never target subset only
evaluation.aggregation: mean over nine decoding cells per seed, then mean and sample SD over three seeds
evaluation.primary_interpretation: unique target yield and unique novel target yield at fixed attempt budget
evaluation.statistics: Exploratory paired two-sided t tests across training seeds; one NEW Bonferroni family of 3 contrasts x 7 metrics = 21. Original 42-test family untouched.
evaluation.limits: n=3 training seeds, one fixed pretraining seed; frozen predictor outputs are not new DFT verification. Differences from soft involve support, weighting, and ChEMBL replay.

scope: No other datasets, external experiment results, predictor refitting, hyperparameter search, new DFT, or existing-run regeneration.

training_execution_amendment.change: Execution only: XLA compilation of the unchanged B_LSTM graph with full float32 matmuls during training/common validation. Final generation and scoring remain unchanged.
training_execution_amendment.reason: Synthetic tensor throughput diagnostic, followed by all311 common-validation-input numerical equivalence check on nonpadding tokens. No generated molecules or predictor target metrics existed at the change.
training_execution_amendment.partial_training_before_amendment: The initial ordinary-graph run reached one complete epoch and part of epoch2 in each seed. Those logs/checkpoints are retained only in _execution_history, excluded from every comparison and result archive.
training_execution_amendment.restart: All three final seeds restart from the identical original ChEMBL-pretrained checkpoint. No partial weights, optimizer states, or prior checkpoints are reused.
unchanged: common validation set and checkpoint-selection rule
decoding sampler, grid, attempt budget and seed rule
training_execution_amendment.precision_disclosure: Existing reference training used its original default backend. The new compiled training uses full float32 matmuls to avoid TF32 approximation. Variables remain float32. No runtime superiority claim will be made.
